name: Elijah Bloom
source: Heir to a hereditary family of wizards, headman of Leonheart, and Cordale's chief smuggler, Elijah is the kind of man who loves life and wants to take everything from it. He often lacks responsibility, but he has a good heart and will always come to the aid of his friends.
